description: This file contains utility functions and constants for parsing and formatting API error payloads, HTTP status codes, and error messages related to AI services and web errors.

methods.name: isErrorPayloadObject
methods.description: Type guard to check if a payload matches the ErrorPayload structure.

methods.name: parseApiErrorPayload
methods.description: Parses a raw string to extract a JSON error payload if present.

methods.name: extractLeadingHttpStatus
methods.description: Extracts HTTP status code and remaining string from a raw input.

methods.name: isCloudflareOrHtmlErrorPage
methods.description: Determines if a raw string represents a Cloudflare or HTML error page based on status code and content.

methods.name: parseApiErrorInfo
methods.description: Extracts structured error information from a raw error string.

methods.name: formatRawAssistantErrorForUi
methods.description: Formats an error message for UI display, handling specific error types and fallback to raw message.
